Brigand

Overview

The brigand meets Kir after the rescue of the Free Hunters and conveys the chief’s invitation. He points toward their camp in the northern Foothills and warns that the goblins guarding it can be dangerous. His brief role provides a personal introduction to the hunters’ settlement. [1]

The Free Hunters and Babur

A messenger invites the rescuers of the hunters to Bor the Cunning’s camp. Bor claims neutrality in the war, yet asks them to act against the village’s hunters and caravans. To question Babur the Tightfist about the Orb, Kir helps bring him out of the village. The letter can go to Babur himself or to the elder, with different explanations for the craftsman’s arrival. Babur then sends Kir to the lizards’ tomb for a supposed magical needle. The expedition supplies lizard hides, and Babur admits that useful armour material was his real interest. For information about the Orb, he redirects the visitors to Estera. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
